The Lucky Cig x4 Pride [Owned] - If 1 ally with the least Ammo uses a Skill that spends Ammo, gain 3 Poise (ocne per turn; does not apply to allies without Ammo) - If 1 ally with the least Ammo uses up their last Ammo with a skill, deal 50% of the skill's damage as bonus damage to that Skill's target at Attack End.

review: Jack of all trades master of none except she's horrible at it. The problem with her is that she uses poise as an enabler for other status effects while having NONE of it. She also has the problem of not being able to maintain her poise count consistently without a second slot, which her entire kit relies on, due to wanting to crit. The only saving grace for her is the effect of her skill 3, which can inflict 8 potency and 4 count of Tremor and Rupture while also bursting Tremor but unfortunately, without critting on the last coin, she will only inflict 4 potency and 2 count for Tremor and Rupture. Additionally, her skill 3 is the only skill that inflicts Tremor and Rupture, making her not that good of a status support. No notable E.G.O. Synergies
